## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for the user.

## Verification

List actual commands/results and relevant behavior evidence. Name checks not run.
Keep offline simulations distinct from native host or device tests.

## Review notes

- [ ] Scope stays focused; no duplicate router or unrelated application changes.
- [ ] Applicable licences, attribution and source hashes remain intact.
- [ ] Package logic has meaningful regression coverage, or the change needs no code test.
- [ ] Version/changelog/validation notes are updated if package behavior changes.
- [ ] No credentials, private data or generated archives are committed.
